summary: Skeletal remains found by a hiker in Skeleton Gulch (west side of Rocky Mountain National Park) in mid-August 2020 were recovered in summer 2021 with FBI Evidence Response Team assistance; believed to be Rudi Moder, 27, of West Germany, missing since a Feb-1983 ski-mountaineering trip over Thunder Pass; closes a ~38-year cold case.
location: Skeleton Gulch, west side of Rocky Mountain National Park
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain National Park Search and Rescue; FBI Evidence Response Team
notes: NPS RMNP news release dated 2021-11-04. MERGED/INSERTED run 987.
